messages:
Mira (sec-eng): Heads up — pre-merge SAST is blocking a bunch of PRs in platform repo. Logs show the scanner cannot decrypt artifacts and CI jobs are failing.

Mira (sec-eng): Here's the snippet from the runner logs:
```bash
2024-09-21T14:12:03Z scanner ERROR decrypt failed: kms:AccessDenied
request id: abc123
resource: projects/redwood/keystore/prod/scanner-key
```

Juan (infra): That was me — I removed 'keystore.decrypt' from scanner service account during a cleanup window yesterday. I didn't realize the premerge SAST runner used that key for fixture decryption. My mistake.

Oliver (devex): To confirm: the SAST job decrypts test fixtures from KMS to run pattern checks locally on CI, right? If so we should have a minimal IAM matrix documented.

Lana (oncall): Oncall saw the spike of CI failures earlier. We put a temporary hold on a few release branches. Short term: can we either grant a scoped allow or change the job to use cached fixtures?

sec-bot: Incident INC-2024-4873 created and assigned to Juan (infra). Notifying keystore-audit and security-oncall.

Mira (sec-eng): Proposed triage + remediation plan:
1) Re-add cloudkms.decrypt permission to the scanner-SA but scope it to the CI project or runner resource.
2) Add an IAM condition requiring resource tag `ci=scanner` to limit blast radius.
3) Add an approval requirement (security signoff) for any future removal of cryptoKeyDecrypter role from scanner-SA.
4) Postmortem note and update docs.

Juan (infra): OK I'll re-add the permission scoped to the CI runner and open a changelog PR now. Applying the following as an example: 
```hcl
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member" "scanner_decrypt" {
  crypto_key_id = "projects/redwood/.../scanner-key"
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
  member        = "serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  condition {
    title       = "CI-scanner-only"
    expression  = "resource.labels.ci == 'scanner'"
  }
}
```

Mira (sec-eng): Please include a changelog entry and link the PR to the incident. Also capture the audit log entry for the rollback. We want traceability for the RBAC flip.

Juan (infra): PR opened: https://git.redwood.co/infra/keystore/pulls/4582 — includes the IAM condition and a note in CHANGELOG.md. Added the audit tag.

Oliver (devex): I'll add a short section to the devdocs mapping scanner CI roles -> required permissions so teammates know which perms to avoid removing. Also adding a pre-merge lint to warn if a PR touches roles.cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter without a security-approval label.

Lana (oncall): Post-fix: I re-ran the blocked PRs against the CI runner and SAST jobs passed for the samples I tried. Looks good. :thumbsup:

Mira (sec-eng): Thanks everyone. Let's schedule a 15-min sync to finalize the RBAC matrix and the approval workflow. I'll assign action items in the incident. Closing thread here.
